annotations.title: Free preview of a new pool's on-chain flags

description: Free, rate limited. For a pool in the launch index: a label from pool events only (swaps, liquidity changes, price moves) and counts of high, medium and info flags. No flag text, token-contract checks or precedent; the paid verdict has those. On-chain facts only: not a safety check, audit or forecast.

token_or_pool_id.description: Token address (0x + 40 hex) or Uniswap v4 pool id (0x + 64 hex), as listed by recent_launches.
